gaps.explanation: Statement p5 General Fund prints transfers gross: Transfers in 439,913, Transfers out (99,121), Net 340,792 (Total Governmental Funds transfers in 810,191, p6). Gross GF in 439,913 - 392,109 = 47,804 (and out 99,121 - 51,317 = 47,804) is netted within departments; the schedule does not print the gross split. Other funds agree (Street 97,260, Economic Development 83,284, Grant 110,182, Capital Projects 79,552). Schedule 762,387 + 47,804 = 810,191. No fix.
